title: Zoning text change to allow Studio 54 rehabilitation bonus transfer
summary: This amends the Zoning Resolution's Theater Subdistrict rules to allow bonus floor area for rehabilitating listed theaters, such as Studio 54 at 254 West 54th Street in Manhattan, to be transferred to other sites. It is tied to a related special permit allowing 187,783 square feet of bonus floor area for the theater's rehabilitation. The Council held a public hearing on the proposal on October 20, 2026.
